title: Exclusive: Lee Atwater's Infamous 1981 Interview on the Southern Strategy
summary: A short audio clip of a 1981 interview in which Republican strategist Lee Atwater explains to a political scientist how the party could win racist voters without using overtly racist language. It was published by The Nation with analysis by Rick Perlstein.
why: HN commenters cite it as a primary source for the Southern Strategy and coded racial language, in Atwater's own words.
